subject: Proposal packet landed — can we run the numbers together?
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Green <sara.green@kestrel.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal packet for Kestrel — pricing + next steps

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for taking the demo yesterday. I pulled together a short proposal packet with the usage-based pricing bands we discussed, a recommended Dedicated footprint for your expected throughput, and an SLA summary. The PDF is attached.

Highlights:  
- Estimated monthly tokens: ~120M (based on 3 prod endpoints + peak batch jobs)
- Suggested Dedicated config: 4x A100-equivalent workers, 2x burst slots for peak inference
- Expected monthly cost range: $18k–$24k (range depends on sustained batching + caching)

If helpful, I can run a 20-minute numbers review with your engineering lead and procurement to walk through assumptions and alternatives (quantization, caching, and routing policies that affect unit cost). Proposed slots: Mon 5/24 10:00–10:20 PT or Tue 5/25 14:30–14:50 PT.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-Pricing-Estimate-Kestrel-20260520.pdf (PDF, 420KB)], [Attachment: SLA-summary-Redwood.xlsx (XLSX, 52KB)]

Appreciate any timing guidance — want to make sure procurement has the right details.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

--
Redwood Inference — making high-performance LLM inference predictable and economical

From: Sara Green <sara.green@kestrel.ai>

Cc: procurement@kestrel.ai
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal packet for Kestrel — pricing + next steps

Hi Dylan —

Sorry for the delay — procurement has been pulling together their internal checklist and I wanted to confirm a couple of items before locking a time. I did receive the packet and the attachments — thanks for sending. Two quick questions:  

1) Can you confirm the data retention window that applies to logs and request payloads for Dedicated? Our compliance team prefers 90 days by default.
2) Is the SLA summary you attached compatible with our regional data-residency requirements (we have a mixed US/EU footprint)?

A 15-minute call next week would be great — how does Tue 6/1 09:30–09:45 PT look for you? If that works I can loop in our engineering manager for the cost assumptions.

Thanks,
Sara Green
Head of Platform Partnerships | Kestrel AI
